author: haiku
label: seeded-07r-01
changes: Rewrote the whole document for a newcomer, in the order: summary, terms, diagram, steps, failure table, open questions.
Added a summary of the main flow and why it is shaped that way (stock held before money moves; money never kept for unfillable orders).
Added a terms section defining service, HTTP call, message broker, event, webhook, payment provider, idempotency key, reservation (hold), claim, refund, and snapshot.

Rebuilt the Mermaid flowchart so every failure branch from the brief is shown: short stock, declined payment, late success after the hold lapsed (stock still free and stock sold), failed refund with retry, and duplicate webhooks. Each node names the service that acts.
Added the service that receives Place order (the Order service, which reads the cart over HTTP). The brief did not name it; this is a decision.
Added the step that releases the hold when a payment is declined. The brief and first draft did not say this; it is a decision so stock is not held for a failed order.
Kept the first draft's re-reserve option for a late success when the stock is still free, and flagged it as an open question because the brief says refund and cancel.

Replaced the first draft's notes with the full rules, each stated once: Payment-only provider calls, idempotency key, webhook dedupe, no partial orders, refunds never dropped, cart emptied only on confirmation.
Kept every requirement from the brief, including the 10-minute hold, the 30-minute webhook delay, the all-or-nothing reservation, the automatic full refund, and the email to the customer.
Removed codes and cross-references; each step stands alone.
Length grew beyond the first draft, because the brief's stated facts and the requested failure branches need the space. No requirement was cut to shorten the file.
Set no exact status names, retry limits or event-recovery rule; these are listed under open questions rather than invented.
